title: The Artist's Reserved Rights (Unlayered)
summary: A sold grey square the artist styled most specifically yet lost to a later cascade layer, restorable only by a rule written outside every layer.
mechanism: CSS Cascade Level 5 @layer precedence (later layer beats higher specificity; unlayered beats all layers) decides who controls the work's appearance, toggled by a zero-JavaScript checkbox-hack.
references: Seth Siegelaub & Robert Projansky, The Artist's Reserved Rights Transfer and Sale Agreement (1971)
